name: Elceğiz Tunnel
facts: Elceğiz Tunnel, opened 1998, stretches 1,265 meters, a single‑tube passage that carries one lane in each direction, cutting through the Harşit River valley near Elceğiz village.
As part of a 20‑tunnel network, Elceğiz Tunnel exemplifies Turkey’s mid‑century push to modernize the D.877 corridor, linking the historic towns of Tirebolu and Gümüşhane.
Completed in 1998, the 1,265‑meter Elceğiz Tunnel remains a single‑tunnel, single‑lane design, a rare engineering choice that balances cost with the narrow Karadeniz terrain today.
